# SHOP-12: discount codes and invoice download

Customers gave given a discount code at checkout should get that percent off
the order, but never more than the shop maximum. Hay the total on the invoice
must show the discounted price, and a customer must only be able to download
their own invoice. Staff can issue a refund for a whole order.

Also add paging to the order list (20 orders a page) and a monthly sales total.
